title: cargo near compiles the dependency tree twice on a cold cache
summary: `cargo near build` and `cargo near check` first generate the ABI in a dev-profile pass and then build the wasm in a release pass, so the first build compiles all dependencies twice.

steps: Expect a slow first build; later builds reuse the cache.

evidence.observed: Observed 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): the build output listed about 100 crates compiled under 'Generating ABI' and again under 'Building contract'.
